version.changelog: AI 直接管理的 Typecho 博客知识库技能 — 支持创建、查询、更新、删除文章

llm.summary: This skill openly helps an AI manage a user-configured Typecho blog, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting posts, with no evidence of hidden or unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Typecho blog/knowledge-base management, and the documented API actions match that purpose: submit, list, get, update, and delete.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some natural-language triggers are broad, but the skill repeatedly frames actions as Typecho/blog operations, requires configuration before use, and includes target confirmation for updates and a second confirmation for deletion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is documentation-only Markdown plus a license; no executable installer, scripts, package hooks, or automatic local commands were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to a configured Typecho endpoint and use of an API token are proportionate to the advertised blog-management function.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to persist the blog domain and API token locally for reuse. That is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should treat the token as sensitive because it enables remote blog changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an AI agent to manage a Typecho blog through an API token. Use a dedicated low-privilege blog user if possible, keep the token out of public chats/logs, leave new posts in draft or waiting status by default, and require explicit confirmation with the target cid before updates or deletion.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The scanner flagged broad trigger phrases. The artifact does include broad examples, but the surrounding text scopes them to Typecho/blog use, requires configured credentials, defaults created posts to review status, and documents target confirmation for update/delete flows.
[SQP-2] expected: The scanner flagged CRUD/delete risk. Full CRUD, including deletion, is openly advertised and coherent with the skill purpose; the main skill instructions explicitly say deletion is irreversible and require a second confirmation before calling the delete API.
